newsitem.title: GREECE: PILAVIOS ELECTED PRESIDENT OF GREEK INSTITUTIONALS.
newsitem.headline: PILAVIOS ELECTED PRESIDENT OF GREEK INSTITUTIONALS.

text.p: The board of directors of the Union of Greek Institutional Investors elected Alexios Pilavios, the managing director of Alpha Invest , as its new president to replace outgoing Pavlos Perratis, the union said in a statement.
Christos Spanos, head of state Commercial Bank's directorate of investments and vice-president of Hermes mutual fund management company, was elected first vice-president, it said.

George Diamantopoulos, managing director of Ergo Invest, was elected second vice-president. Alexandros Papas, managing director of Alico-Eurobank mutual fund management company, was elected general secretary.
Leonidas Tosidis, managing director of Dias, was elected treasurer, it said.
Theodosis Boudourakis of Intertrust mutual fund management company and Philippos Boukouvalas of Kosmos Sogen mutual fund management company are board members.

The board of directors of the Union of Greek Institutional investors decided to continue its efforts to find a fair solution to the pending tax problem, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
